name: John Snider
dateNote: He was baptized in Toronto in 1836; section 124 names him in January 1841.
importance: Section 124 names him with George Miller, Lyman Wight, and Peter Haws to build the Nauvoo House. It tells them to use stock only for that house. He also served missions to Britain in 1837 and 1842–1843.
connections: He worked with George Miller, Lyman Wight, and Peter Haws on the Nauvoo House. He married Mary Heron in 1822.

sources.title: John Snider (Snyder), Joseph Smith Papers biography

reviewNote: JSP: born 11 Feb. 1800, New Brunswick, Canada; baptized 1836 at Toronto; mission to England 1837; seventy 1839; Nauvoo House Association 1841; mission to the UK 1842–1843; died 19 Dec. 1875, Salt Lake City. Mason and stonecutter.
